characters.note: Deadly Indian snake trained by Roylott to return via the ventilator; kills Dr. Roylott.

characters.name: Mrs. Hudson

characters.name: Mrs. Farintosh

brief.place: Baker Street, London; the Surrey countryside around Leatherhead; Stoke Moran Manor, an old grey lichen-blotched stone house with a central block and two curving wings, one ruined.
brief.dress: Victorian dress: Holmes in a dressing-gown or frock-coat; Helen in black mourning dress with a heavy veil; Roylott in a black top-hat, long frock-coat, high gaiters and carrying a hunting-crop, and later in a long grey dressing-gown and red Turkish slippers with a yellow speckled band around his head.
brief.buildings_and_objects: Brown worm-eaten oak panelling, narrow white-counterpaned bed clamped to the floor, dummy bell-rope tassel on the pillow, ventilator opening above the bed, shutters with iron bars, iron safe, saucer of milk, dark-lantern, the dog-lash with whipcord loop, poker bent in a curve, Eley's No. 2 revolver.
depiction_rules: The baboon and cheetah are animals, never shown as human figures.
The swamp adder is a loathsome serpent with a squat diamond-shaped head and puffed neck; it should be visible as a snake rising from Roylott's hair, not as a band.
Roylott's speckled band should read as a yellow band with brownish speckles around his brow, which turns out to be the snake.
Julia appears only in recollection and should not be drawn on stage in the present scenes.
Do not show the gipsies on stage; they remain offstage in the plantation.
